reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Butler project-create durable retry receipt, name race guard, and existing project lifecycle journey
reason: Eleven collected Python cases cover Butler project action discovery, Core project-create receipt replay, changed-payload and deleted-target conflicts, two concurrent create races, legacy Host consent, and packaged product guidance with Chroma source-digest sync. Sixty-six listed frontend cases cover the typed receipt, request-ID API body, preflight failures, archive confirmation, and Core readback. Eight paired browser profiles run the selected Butler project lifecycle against disposable authenticated LAN Core and a production bundle; the journey now verifies a lost response, exact Core receipt replay, and conflicts for changed details and a separate same-name request.
exclusions: No native source changed, so no native tests are selected. Unrelated Python, frontend, and Playwright journeys are excluded. Browser profiles emulate mobile devices; physical Safari is unavailable. The name guard applies to Butler keyed creates; unkeyed project creation retains its existing semantics.
